summary: A bug-fix release with no new features. 2-pass lossless x265 encodes no longer crash, 2-pass MPEG-4, MPEG-2, VP9 and FFV1 encodes no longer leak memory, and VobSub subtitle colors in MP4 files are fixed. On Windows, audio tracks get proper names again and HDR video is described correctly in the summary. FFmpeg is now 8.0.2.
